$description: The web kit (kit/): brand sections, marketing titles and page rhythm for websites, landing pages and other Fume pages in HTML. PROPOSED, 13 Oct 2026 (Marcus: pages made with the connector came out off brand: square buttons, the wrong type). Every colour points at the palette; Brown and Paper are their own family (F-D079). Component file: kit/web.css. Built into --ui-web-<key> by node tools/tokens/build.mjs.

ground-brand.description: A dark brand section: Brown, with Paper text. Website, decks and social only; never a card, a button or product UI, where Ink makes every decision (RULES Colour, F-D079). Never two in a row.

text-on-brand.description: Text and the logo on a Brown section, 12.2:1. Never Ink on Brown (1.4:1).

text-on-brand-secondary.description: Quieter text on Brown (a label over a title), 9.1:1.

frame.description: The Focus frame's corners and point on a photograph, on a light image or a dark one (F-D082). On a flat ground the frame is Paper on Ink or Brown and Ink on Paper or Porcelain. Amber only where the check lands (--ui-check).

title-on-warm.description: A marketing title on a Paper section: Brown, 12.2:1, as on the deck's cover, dividers and contact slide. Running text on Paper stays Ink.

point.description: The Amber point that ends a statement on Brown (deck D5; Amber point on dark, F-O020). A point, never text, a surface or light on Brown. One per page.

light-ground.description: The ground the brand light sits on (Light board L1, L2, L5). Light only on Paper or Cream, never on Ink or Brown, never behind small text.

light-soft.description: The light's soft wash (L1, L5): Amber 100, blurred wide, so it reads as light, never as a colour block.

light-core.description: The light's core (L2, L3, L5), blurred so far it is light, not a shape. Never a fill anyone could read as an Amber surface.

page.description: Widest the page's content gets, the same as the brand book.

measure.description: Running text and ledes never run wider than this.

gutter.description: Space between the content and the window's edge: 24 px, 16 on a phone (gutter-phone).

section.description: Space above and below the content of a section: 96 px, 64 on a phone (section-phone). Sections are told apart by their ground and this space, never by lines.

section-phone.description: The section space under 760 px: 64 px.

title-gap.description: Between a title and the lede or text under it: 24 px. The next group sits at least twice as far away (rule proximity).

group-gap.description: Between groups in a section (a lede and its buttons, a title and its cards): 48 px.

header.description: Height of the page header's row: the logo on the left, one action on the right.

logo.description: Width of the horizontal logo lockup in the page header (the official file, never redrawn).
